user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hello, I’m having some trouble with my phone. I’ve been trying to send a picture message—what I think you call an MMS?—but it just won’t go through. This has been happening for a few hours now. Can you help me fix it?

To assist you with the MMS issue, I first need to identify you as a customer. Could you please provide me with your phone number or your full name along with your date of birth? This will help me look up your account and check the status of your line and services.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Do you also need my date of birth, or is that enough?

For name-based lookup, I do need your date of birth for verification. Since you provided your phone number, I can use that to find your account without needing your date of birth. I will proceed with the phone number lookup now.

I have identified your account and the line associated with your phone number 555-123-2002. Your current plan has a data limit of 15 GB, and it appears you have used 15.1 GB of data this cycle, which is slightly over your data limit. This could be a reason why your MMS is not sending, as MMS requires mobile data to be active.

To resolve this, you have two options:
1. Refuel (add) more data to your line.
2. Change to a plan with a higher data limit.

Would you like to add more data to your current plan, or would you prefer to explore other plan options? If you want to add data, please let me know how much data (up to 2 GB) you want to add.

Oh, I definitely don’t want to change my plan—I’m happy with what I have. If adding more data will help, I’m okay with that. Can you please add 2 GB for me? I just want to be able to send my pictures again.

The price for refueling 2 GB of data on your current plan is $2.00 per GB, so the total cost will be $4.00. 

I will proceed with adding 2 GB of data to your line now.
